proposed_interpretation: No unconditional guarantee follows from these pages. SQLite relies on the storage stack honoring its assumptions; losing committed work and database corruption are distinct outcomes.

alternatives.hypothesis: A successful save survives every power-loss situation.
alternatives.proposed_outcome: unsupported within the bounded documentation review

alternatives.hypothesis: The outcome depends on storage and flush semantics.
alternatives.proposed_outcome: supported as a documentation interpretation, not a hardware measurement
